boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Belmont University
boards.description: Belmont's location near Music Row and the 21st Avenue corridor offers students a mix of on-campus autonomous markets and legendary Nashville late-night staples.

cards.title: The 24/7 Campus Lifeline
cards.subtitle: Wiseman Hall
cards.notes: Visit this autonomous on-campus market any time of day or night for snacks and essentials using your Bruin Card for entry.
cards.short_summary: An autonomous 24-hour on-campus market located in Wiseman Hall providing round-the-clock access to food and supplies.
cards.evidence_claim: Bear Necessities in Wiseman Hall transitioned to 24-hour service to provide students with late-night dining options on campus.
cards.source_title: Bear Necessities Now Open 24 Hours - Belmont Vision
cards.access_notes: Open 24/7; requires student ID for entry during late-night hours.

cards.title: The Post-Gig Milkshake Run
cards.subtitle: West End Avenue
cards.notes: Drive through for a 'Cook Out Tray' and choose from over 40 milkshake flavors until the early morning hours.
cards.short_summary: A beloved regional fast-food chain famous for its inexpensive 'trays' and extensive milkshake menu, open until 3:30 AM or later.
cards.evidence_claim: Cook Out on West End Avenue is open until 3:30 AM Sunday-Thursday and 4:30 AM on Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Open until 3:30 AM (Sun-Thu) and 4:30 AM (Fri-Sat).

cards.title: Late-Night Global Flavors
cards.subtitle: Midtown
cards.notes: Order creative tacos like Spicy Tikka Chicken or Nashville Tofu at this Midtown spot that stays open well past midnight.
cards.short_summary: An eclectic taco restaurant offering international flavors and a late-night menu for students and locals in the Midtown area.
cards.evidence_claim: Velvet Taco Midtown is open until 12 AM Sunday-Wednesday, 2 AM on Thursday, and 4 AM on Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Open until 2 AM on Thursdays and 4 AM on Fridays/Saturdays.

cards.title: The Midnight Heat Check
cards.subtitle: Midtown
cards.notes: Test your spice tolerance with authentic Nashville hot chicken at this iconic location open late on weekends.
cards.short_summary: A premier destination for Nashville hot chicken, offering various heat levels and Southern sides in a casual setting.
cards.evidence_claim: Hattie B's Midtown location serves hot chicken until 11 PM on weeknights and 12 AM on Fridays and Saturdays.
cards.access_notes: Open until 11 PM (Mon-Thu) and 12 AM (Fri-Sat).

cards.title: The Late-Night Slice
cards.subtitle: Charlotte Avenue
cards.notes: Grab a New York-style slice or a whole pie at the walk-up window during late-night hours on the weekend.
cards.short_summary: A popular pizza shop known for its New York-style thin crust and convenient walk-up window for late-night service.
cards.evidence_claim: Five Points Pizza West is open until 11 PM on weeknights and 12 AM on Fridays and Saturdays.
cards.access_notes: Open until 12 AM on Fridays and Saturdays.

cards.title: Downtown Burger Run
cards.subtitle: Assembly Food Hall
cards.notes: Head downtown to the Assembly Food Hall for a late-night burger and old-fashioned soda at this local favorite.
cards.short_summary: A Nashville staple for craft burgers and house-made sodas, located within the vibrant Assembly Food Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: The Pharmacy Burger at Assembly Food Hall is open until 12 AM on Fridays and Saturdays.
cards.source_title: The Pharmacy Burger - Assembly Food Hall
cards.access_notes: Open until 12 AM on Friday and Saturday nights.

cards.title: Wagyu Burgers Near Campus
cards.subtitle: Edgehill
cards.notes: Walk over to Edgehill for a simple, high-quality Wagyu beef burger at this neighborhood spot open until 2 AM daily.
cards.short_summary: A casual burger joint specializing in Wagyu beef burgers and a large selection of craft beers, welcoming all ages for food.
cards.evidence_claim: Jack Brown's Edgehill location is open daily from 11 AM to 2 AM.
cards.access_notes: Open until 2 AM every night; under-21 safe for dining.

cards.title: The Midnight Country Breakfast
cards.subtitle: Germantown
cards.notes: Experience a family-style Southern breakfast including fried chicken and biscuits at this unique Saturday night tradition.
cards.short_summary: A historic Germantown restaurant offering a famous 'Midnight Country Breakfast' on Saturday nights.
cards.evidence_claim: Monell's in Germantown hosts a Midnight Country Breakfast every Saturday from 11 PM to 3 AM.
cards.access_notes: Midnight breakfast available Saturdays only, 11 PM - 3 AM.

cards.title: Six Floors of Late-Night Dining
cards.subtitle: SoBro
cards.notes: Visit this multi-story diner downtown for a full menu ranging from breakfast to sushi available late into the night.
cards.short_summary: A 24/7-style upscale diner in the SoBro district featuring multiple floors and a diverse menu for any hour.
cards.evidence_claim: The Diner Nashville is open until 2 AM on Fridays and Saturdays, serving a full menu to late-night patrons.
cards.access_notes: Open until 2 AM on Friday and Saturday nights.

cards.title: The Early Bird or Late Night
cards.subtitle: Hillsboro Village
cards.notes: While famous for morning lines, check for seasonal extended evening hours at this legendary Hillsboro Village landmark.
cards.short_summary: Nashville's most famous pancake house, a tradition for students in the nearby Hillsboro Village neighborhood.
cards.evidence_claim: Pancake Pantry in Hillsboro Village is a long-standing Nashville tradition located within walking distance of Belmont.
cards.access_notes: Standard hours are 6 AM - 3 PM; check for seasonal evening hours.

boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Discover the functional student-preferred spaces across Belmont's campus, from quiet library corners to specialized academic lounges and scenic outdoor balconies.

cards.entity_name: Lila D. Bunch Library Sensory Room
cards.title: Sensory Room at Bunch Library
cards.subtitle: Lila D. Bunch Library
cards.notes: Book this specialized space using your Belmont email for a controlled environment designed to support focused study and sensory needs.
cards.short_summary: A reservable sensory-friendly study space located within the main campus library.
cards.evidence_claim: The Lila D. Bunch Library offers a Sensory Room that students can book using their Belmont email address.
cards.source_title: Space Availability - Lila D. Bunch Library - LibCal
cards.access_notes: Accessible during library hours; requires advance reservation via LibCal.

cards.title: JAAC Fourth Floor Balcony
cards.subtitle: Janet Ayers Academic Center
cards.notes: Head to the fourth floor for an outdoor study session with a direct view of the Nashville skyline and 15th Avenue.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor balcony on the 4th floor of the JAAC offering panoramic views of downtown Nashville.
cards.evidence_claim: The 4th floor of the Janet Ayers Academic Center (JAAC) features an outdoor balcony with views of the Nashville skyline.
cards.source_title: Best Studying Spots at Belmont - Her Campus
cards.access_notes: Open during academic building hours; best used during daylight for the view.

cards.title: Gabhart Center Study Cubicles
cards.subtitle: Gabhart Student Center
cards.notes: Located to the right of the bookstore, this area features individual cubicles and conference rooms for intensive solo or group work.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated student study zone within the Gabhart Center featuring cubicles and meeting rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: The Gabhart Student Center includes a student area with cubicles and conference rooms located near the campus bookstore.
cards.access_notes: Centrally located hub; open during standard student center hours.

cards.title: Johnson Center Quiet Zones
cards.subtitle: R. Milton & Denice Johnson Center
cards.notes: Utilize the quiet seating areas outside classrooms on the 3rd and 4th floors, often available late into the evening.
cards.short_summary: Quiet study alcoves located on the upper floors of the Johnson Center, popular for late-night sessions.
cards.evidence_claim: The 3rd and 4th floors of the Johnson Center provide quiet spaces outside classrooms for studying and group projects.
cards.source_title: Facilities & Virtual Tours | Mike Curb College
cards.access_notes: Known for being open late; check building security for specific closing times.

cards.title: BMRC Third Floor Lounge
cards.subtitle: Barbara Massey Rogers Center
cards.notes: Find the student lounge on the 3rd floor of the former Massey Business Center for a dedicated space near computer labs.
cards.short_summary: A student-focused lounge and computer lab area on the third floor of the BMRC.
cards.evidence_claim: The 3rd floor of the Barbara Massey Rogers Center (BMRC) houses a student lounge and computer labs.
cards.access_notes: Primary academic home for business students; open during building hours.

cards.title: Curb Cafe Student Stage
cards.subtitle: Curb Cafe
cards.notes: Book the stage on Thursday through Saturday nights to showcase your music or catch live sets from fellow students.
cards.short_summary: A student-run performance venue and cafe located within the Curb Event Center complex.
cards.evidence_claim: The Curb Cafe is available for students to book live shows on Thursday, Friday, and Saturday nights.
cards.access_notes: Performance bookings are managed via email; open to the community for dining.

cards.title: McWhorter Hall Common Areas
cards.subtitle: McWhorter Hall
cards.notes: Visit the first floor for health services or find quiet corners near the labs in this modern health sciences facility.
cards.short_summary: Common areas and student services located in the McWhorter Hall health sciences building.
cards.evidence_claim: McWhorter Hall contains student health services and pharmacy on the first floor, with research labs on upper levels.
cards.access_notes: Includes a four-level underground parking garage for easy access.

cards.title: Beaman Center Student Lounge
cards.subtitle: Beaman Student Life Center
cards.notes: A central gathering spot for student organizations and casual study, located on the south end of the building.
cards.short_summary: A multi-purpose student lounge and organization hub in the Beaman Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The Beaman Student Life Center houses student organizations and a student lounge.
cards.source_title: Beaman Student Life Center - Belmont University
cards.access_notes: Connected to the Curb Event Center via the Maddox Grand Atrium.

cards.title: Hitch Hall Studio Spaces
cards.subtitle: Hitch Hall
cards.notes: Home to the O'More College of Architecture & Design, this building offers specialized studio floors for design students.
cards.short_summary: Specialized design and architecture studio spaces located in the renovated Hitch Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Hitch Hall features over 22,000 square feet of studio space for the O'More College of Architecture & Design.
cards.source_title: O'More Facilities & Virtual Tour | Belmont University
cards.access_notes: Access primarily for design students; features 3D printers and laser cutters.

cards.title: Foutch Alumni House Porch
cards.subtitle: Foutch Alumni House
cards.notes: The last remaining historic clubhouse on the campus interior, offering a quiet spot next to the iconic Bell Tower.
cards.short_summary: A historic building on campus that serves as a gathering place for the Belmont community.
cards.evidence_claim: The Foutch Alumni House is the last remaining historic clubhouse on the campus interior, located next to the Bell Tower.
cards.access_notes: Open Monday through Friday, 8:30am to 4:30pm for visitors and alumni.

boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Discover free social spaces and activities at Belmont University, from art galleries and carillon concerts to student-only fitness and recreation hubs.

cards.title: Leu Art Gallery
cards.subtitle: Lila D. Bunch Library
cards.notes: Visit this professional gallery space inside the library to view rotating exhibitions by established artists. Admission is free and open to the public during library hours.
cards.short_summary: A free professional art gallery located within the Lila D. Bunch Library.
cards.evidence_claim: While all galleries are free and open to the public, we ask that visitors understand that our gallery hours are subject to change based on the academic calendar and holidays.
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Friday 9am-4:30pm, Saturday 10am-4:30pm, and Sunday 1-5pm.

cards.title: Bell Tower Carillon Concerts
cards.subtitle: Belmont Bell Tower
cards.notes: Listen to live music played on the 42-bell carillon. Traditional concerts occur throughout the year, including a signature free performance every Christmas Eve at 1:00 p.m.
cards.short_summary: Free live musical performances played on the historic campus carillon.
cards.evidence_claim: The concert features traditional Christmas music played on the tower's 42-bell carillon... Date: Thursday, December 24, 2026. Time: 1:00 p.m. Venue: Bell Tower.
cards.source_title: All Events | The College of Music and Performing Arts at Belmont University
cards.access_notes: Outdoor event; public viewing and listening are free around the Bell Tower area.

cards.title: Beaman Student Life Center
cards.subtitle: Campus Social Hub
cards.notes: Hang out in the central student hub featuring lounges and meeting spaces. It is the primary spot for student organizations and casual social gatherings between classes.
cards.short_summary: The main student center at Belmont offering free lounge and social spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: The Beaman Student Life Center... is ideal for hosting a variety of events: meetings, receptions, dinners, seminars, workshops, screenings and more.
cards.source_title: Beaman Student Life Center - Belmont University
cards.access_notes: Open daily for students; specific hours vary by semester.

cards.title: Belmont Mansion Grounds
cards.subtitle: Historic Estate Gardens
cards.notes: Walk through the meticulously maintained rose gardens and grounds of this historic 1850s estate. While mansion tours require a fee, the exterior grounds are free to explore.
cards.short_summary: The historic gardens and exterior grounds of the Belmont Mansion.
cards.evidence_claim: Then, take an optional self-guided tour of the meticulously maintained rose garden and grounds now part of the Belmont University campus... starting from the front steps.
cards.access_notes: Grounds are accessible during daylight hours; interior tours require a paid ticket.

cards.title: FitRec Group Fitness Classes
cards.subtitle: Beaman Student Life Center
cards.notes: Join free group fitness sessions including Yoga, Pilates, and Barre. These classes are included for all degree-seeking students as part of their standard student fees.
cards.short_summary: Free group exercise classes for Belmont students at the fitness center.
cards.evidence_claim: Degree-seeking students who are enrolled in classes and have paid the applicable student fees... receive access to the fitness center... Available Group Fitness Classes: Barre, Yoga, Pilates.
cards.source_title: Group Fitness & Special Events - Belmont University
cards.access_notes: Requires a valid Belmont Student ID for entry and participation.

cards.title: Fannie Mae Dees Park
cards.subtitle: Dragon Park
cards.notes: Relax at this public park adjacent to campus, famous for its large mosaic dragon sculpture. It is a popular spot for students to picnic or study outdoors for free.
cards.short_summary: A public park near campus known for its iconic mosaic dragon sculpture.
cards.evidence_claim: While parking can be a challenge, the park's free admission and convenient location near Hillsboro Village make it a highly recommended destination.
cards.source_title: Fannie Mae Dees Park Picnic Shelter - Nashville.gov
cards.access_notes: Public park open from dawn until 11:00 p.m. daily.

cards.title: Bruin Athletic Events
cards.subtitle: Curb Event Center
cards.notes: Attend home basketball and volleyball games for free. Students simply scan their Belmont ID at the door to support the Bruins in NCAA Division I action.
cards.short_summary: Free admission for students to all home athletic games at the Curb Event Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Students get in free to all home men's and women's basketball games with their student ID... Students get in to all home volleyball games free.
cards.access_notes: Valid Belmont Student ID required for free entry; doors typically open 60 minutes before tip-off.

cards.title: Gabhart Flex Room
cards.subtitle: Gabhart Student Center
cards.notes: Utilize this versatile multipurpose space for student-led activities and gatherings. It is a dedicated area for student programming and informal group meetups.
cards.short_summary: A flexible student-only space for meetings and social programming.
cards.evidence_claim: Located in the corner of the Gabhart Student Center... this versatile multipurpose space is designed to support a wide range of student programming and events.
cards.access_notes: Accessible to students during building hours; can be reserved for specific organization events.

cards.title: Gallery 121
cards.subtitle: Leu Center for the Visual Arts
cards.notes: Explore student and emerging artist exhibitions in this dedicated gallery. It hosts annual juried student shows and BFA senior exhibitions, all free to the public.
cards.short_summary: A campus gallery showcasing student and emerging artist works.
cards.evidence_claim: Gallery 121 is located inside the Leu Center for the Visual Arts... This space is dedicated to exhibitions that enhance the educational mission... admission is always free.
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Friday 8:00 a.m. to 4:30 p.m.

cards.title: Library Computer & Internet Use
cards.subtitle: Lila D. Bunch Library
cards.notes: Access online resources and general internet for free at library computer stations. This service is available to both students and community guests during designated hours.
cards.short_summary: Free public access to computers and internet at the campus library.
cards.evidence_claim: Guests may use the library's computers to access Belmont's online resources or for general internet use... Guests may access the library building from 9am to 5pm Monday through Saturday.
cards.source_title: Q. Can guests access the library? - Ask Lila!
cards.access_notes: Guest access is limited to 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Monday-Saturday and 1:00 p.m. to 5:00 p.m. Sunday.

boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Discover ten distinct study environments across Belmont University, from high-tech labs to quiet reading rooms and scenic balconies.

cards.entity_name: Lila D. Bunch Library 2nd Floor Reading Room
cards.title: The Quiet Zone
cards.subtitle: Lila D. Bunch Library
cards.notes: Utilize this designated quiet workspace for deep focus. Silence all devices and keep conversations to a minimum while using the individual carrels or soft seating.
cards.short_summary: A strictly quiet individual study area located on the second floor of the main campus library.
cards.evidence_claim: The 2nd Floor Reading Room is designated as a quiet workspace at Lila D. Bunch Library.
cards.access_notes: Open during standard library hours; check real-time crowd levels online before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Janet Ayers Academic Center 4th Floor Balcony
cards.title: Skyline Study Views
cards.subtitle: Janet Ayers Academic Center
cards.notes: Head to the fourth floor for an outdoor study session with views of downtown Nashville. This open-air space is ideal for reading when the weather is clear.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor balcony overlooking 15th Avenue and the Nashville skyline, located in the JAAC.
cards.evidence_claim: The 4th floor of the Janet Ayers Academic Center features a balcony overlooking 15th Avenue with views of downtown Nashville.
cards.source_title: Best Studying Spots at Belmont - Her Campus
cards.access_notes: Accessible to students during building operating hours; primarily used for individual study or small breaks.

cards.title: The Cubicle Hub
cards.subtitle: Gabhart Student Center
cards.notes: Find a dedicated room full of cubicles for intensive individual work. The lobby also offers couches and high-top tables for more casual group projects.
cards.short_summary: A central student hub featuring a mix of social lobby seating and private study cubicles.
cards.evidence_claim: The Gabhart Student Center includes a room full of cubicles for hard-core studying and a spacious lobby with couches and high-top tables.
cards.source_title: Best Studying Spots at Belmont - Her Campus
cards.access_notes: Located to the right of the bookstore; open to all students for individual or group work.

cards.title: The Academic Heart
cards.subtitle: Randall and Sadie Baskin Center
cards.notes: Access over 300 seats and reserve group study rooms in this two-story facility. It provides a professional atmosphere with ample outlets and research assistance.
cards.short_summary: A specialized law library offering extensive seating and reservable rooms for focused research.
cards.evidence_claim: The law library in the Baskin Center provides seating for over 300 students and allows law students to reserve group study rooms.
cards.access_notes: Seating is available for over 300; check specific library hours as they may differ from the main library.

cards.title: The Creative Corridor
cards.subtitle: R. Milton & Denice Johnson Center
cards.notes: Use the quiet spaces outside classrooms for individual study or group meetings. This building is often open late, making it a reliable spot for evening sessions.
cards.short_summary: Quiet study and gathering spaces located on the upper floors of the Johnson Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The 3rd and 4th floors of the Johnson Center have quiet spaces outside classrooms for studying or group projects and are open late.
cards.source_title: Best Studying Spots at Belmont - Her Campus
cards.access_notes: Open late at night; accessible to all students, though popular with music business majors.

cards.entity_name: Lila D. Bunch Library Sensory Room
cards.title: The De-Stimulation Retreat
cards.subtitle: Lila D. Bunch Library
cards.notes: Reserve this private space for a quiet retreat from campus noise. It features calming lights, a white noise machine, and fidget tools for focused relaxation.
cards.short_summary: A specialized room designed for neurodivergent students needing a low-sensory environment.
cards.evidence_claim: The Sensory Room in the Lila D. Bunch Library offers soothing lighting, white noise, and sensory tools, accessible via a reservation system.
cards.source_title: Sensory Room Officially Opens at Belmont Library
cards.access_notes: Requires reservation through a QR code or link to receive a PIN code for entry.

cards.entity_name: Barbara Massey Rogers Center Collaboration Lab
cards.title: The Business Hub
cards.subtitle: Barbara Massey Rogers Center
cards.notes: Gather on the first floor for team-based research and project management. This lab is designed for collaborative work within the College of Business.
cards.short_summary: A first-floor lab dedicated to collaborative student work and business-focused research.
cards.evidence_claim: The Barbara Massey Rogers Center features a Collaboration Lab on the 1st floor for students and faculty to gather.
cards.access_notes: Located on the first floor; open during building hours for business students and collaborators.

cards.entity_name: McWhorter Hall Lobby and Study Areas
cards.title: The Health Science Nook
cards.subtitle: McWhorter Hall
cards.notes: Find a quiet spot near the Student Health Services suite or the campus pharmacy. These areas offer a calm environment away from the main campus thoroughfares.
cards.short_summary: Quiet seating areas located within the health sciences building near the campus pharmacy.
cards.evidence_claim: McWhorter Hall contains student space and gathering areas on the first floor near the Health Services clinic and pharmacy.
cards.access_notes: Open during standard academic building hours; accessible to all students.

cards.title: The Social Study Spot
cards.subtitle: Curb Cafe
cards.notes: Study in a more active environment with background music and coffee nearby. It is a popular choice for those who prefer ambient noise over strict silence.
cards.short_summary: A lively cafe environment that serves as a social study space during the day.
cards.evidence_claim: The Curb Cafe is cited by students as a top place to study, offering a more social atmosphere than the library.
cards.access_notes: Open during cafe operating hours; may be louder during peak dining times or events.

cards.entity_name: Gordon E. Inman Center Study Rooms
cards.title: The Reflective Lab
cards.subtitle: Gordon E. Inman Center
cards.notes: Utilize tables and chairs designed for reflective thinking exercises. These spaces are often quieter and used by health science students for focused review.
cards.short_summary: Study spaces integrated into the health sciences labs for individual or group review.
cards.evidence_claim: The Inman Center lab spaces are outfitted with tables and chairs for reflective thinking exercises and student review.
cards.access_notes: Primarily located on the first through third floors; accessible during building hours.

boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Explore the corridors and micro-districts surrounding Belmont University, from the historic recording studios of Music Row to the trendy boutiques of 12 South.

cards.title: Bongo Java
cards.subtitle: Belmont Boulevard Corridor
cards.notes: Visit Nashville's oldest coffeehouse for a local brew. It is a staple for students and faculty located directly across from the university's main entrance.
cards.short_summary: A historic coffeehouse and student hub located on the Belmont Boulevard corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Bongo Java is a walkable, crowd-favorite coffee shop right across from Belmont University on Belmont Boulevard.
cards.source_title: Plan Your Visit | L. Gregory Jones - President of Belmont University
cards.access_notes: Open daily for walk-in service; outdoor seating available.

cards.title: Sevier Park
cards.subtitle: 12 South District
cards.notes: Walk through this 20-acre green space featuring a community center and walking trails. It serves as the southern anchor of the popular 12 South shopping district.
cards.short_summary: A large public park and community hub at the southern end of the 12 South district.
cards.evidence_claim: Sevier Park borders the 12 South neighborhood to the south and features walking trails and a community center.
cards.access_notes: Public park open daily from dawn to dusk; free admission.

cards.title: Belcourt Theatre
cards.subtitle: Hillsboro Village Corridor
cards.notes: Catch an independent or classic film at this historic non-profit cinema. It has been a cultural landmark in Hillsboro Village since 1925.
cards.short_summary: A historic independent cinema located in the Hillsboro Village shopping district.
cards.evidence_claim: The Belcourt Theatre is a nearby cultural attraction in Hillsboro Village offering a range of classic and independent films.
cards.source_title: Belmont & Hillsboro Village Neighborhoods | Visit Nashville TN
cards.access_notes: Open for scheduled screenings; tickets can be purchased online or at the box office.

cards.title: RCA Studio B
cards.subtitle: Music Row District
cards.notes: Tour the legendary studio where Elvis Presley and Dolly Parton recorded hits. It is a cornerstone of the historic Music Row district near campus.
cards.short_summary: A historic recording studio and museum located in the heart of Music Row.
cards.evidence_claim: Historic RCA Studio B is a notable location on Music Row where legendary artists like Elvis Presley recorded many hits.
cards.access_notes: Tours are available by appointment; tickets are required for entry.

cards.title: Edgehill Village
cards.subtitle: Villa Place Corridor
cards.notes: Explore this micro-district featuring boutiques and eateries like Bella Napoli. It is a small but vibrant commercial pocket just north of campus.
cards.short_summary: A boutique commercial district located on Villa Place in the Edgehill neighborhood.
cards.evidence_claim: Edgehill Village is a quaint neighborhood with popular spots for students, including shops and restaurants on Villa Place.
cards.access_notes: Publicly accessible commercial area; individual business hours vary.

cards.title: The Pancake Pantry
cards.subtitle: 21st Avenue South Corridor
cards.notes: Join the line at this Nashville institution for scratch-made pancakes. It is a landmark destination on the 21st Avenue corridor near Hillsboro Village.
cards.short_summary: A famous breakfast restaurant located on the 21st Avenue South corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: The Pancake Pantry is a Nashville staple located along 21st Avenue South, just west of the Belmont campus.
cards.source_title: 8 Best Neighborhoods Near Belmont University in Nashville
cards.access_notes: Open daily for breakfast and lunch; expect wait times on weekends.

cards.title: Acklen Avenue
cards.subtitle: Acklen Avenue Corridor
cards.notes: Walk this residential and commercial street that connects Belmont to Hillsboro Village. It features local favorites like Dose Coffee and student housing.
cards.short_summary: A key connector street between Belmont University and the Hillsboro Village district.
cards.evidence_claim: Acklen Avenue is a neighborhood corridor near Belmont University featuring restaurants like Dose Coffee and residential units.
cards.source_title: Apartments near Belmont University | 2100 Acklen Flats | Map
cards.access_notes: Public city street; walkable from the Belmont campus.

cards.title: Wedgewood-Houston
cards.subtitle: Wedgewood Avenue Corridor
cards.notes: Visit this industrial-turned-arts district for gallery crawls and creative spaces. It is located just east of the university along Wedgewood Avenue.
cards.short_summary: An artistic and creative district located along the Wedgewood Avenue corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Wedgewood-Houston is an artistic hub in Nashville featuring art galleries and creative businesses like Elegy Coffee.
cards.source_title: Welcome To Wedgewood-Houston: An Artistic Hub In Nashville, TN
cards.access_notes: Public district; hosts the 'Arts & Music at Wedgewood-Houston' crawl on the first Saturday of each month.

cards.title: Frothy Monkey
cards.subtitle: 12 South Corridor
cards.notes: Dine at the original location of this local coffeehouse chain. It is a central meeting spot for the 12 South neighborhood's residents and visitors.
cards.short_summary: A popular local coffeehouse and restaurant in the 12 South district.
cards.evidence_claim: Frothy Monkey's original location is a standout place in the 12 South neighborhood.
cards.source_title: 12 South in Nashville - Restaurants and Things to Do
cards.access_notes: Open daily for breakfast, lunch, and dinner.

cards.title: International Market
cards.subtitle: Belmont Boulevard Corridor
cards.notes: Enjoy authentic Thai cuisine at this James Beard-recognized restaurant. It has served the Belmont community since 1975 from its location on Belmont Blvd.
cards.short_summary: A historic Thai restaurant and market located on the Belmont Boulevard corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: International Market & Restaurant has fed generations of Belmont University students since 1975 and is located on Belmont Blvd.
cards.access_notes: Open for lunch and dinner; closed on certain holidays.

boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: From the high-stakes Battle of the Boulevard to the nationally televised Christmas at Belmont, these traditions define the Bruin experience in the heart of Music City.

cards.title: Towering Traditions
cards.subtitle: The Start of the Bruin Journey
cards.notes: Participate in this multi-day orientation where new students are sorted into Tower Teams led by upperclassmen to learn campus culture.
cards.short_summary: Towering Traditions (TT) is Belmont's signature orientation program for new students.
cards.evidence_claim: Towering Traditions is the unforgettable orientation experience welcoming new Bruins into the Belmont story, featuring Tower Team leaders.
cards.access_notes: Mandatory for all incoming first-year and transfer students during Welcome Week.

cards.title: Battle of the Boulevard
cards.subtitle: The Rivalry with Lipscomb
cards.notes: Wear navy and red to cheer on the Bruins as they face off against cross-town rival Lipscomb University in this historic basketball series.
cards.short_summary: The Battle of the Boulevard is the intense basketball rivalry between Belmont and Lipscomb University.
cards.evidence_claim: The Battle of the Boulevard is a college basketball rivalry between the Belmont Bruins and Lipscomb Bisons, located just three miles apart.
cards.access_notes: Games alternate between Belmont's Curb Event Center and Lipscomb's Allen Arena.

cards.title: Christmas at Belmont
cards.subtitle: A Nationally Televised Holiday Concert
cards.notes: Watch over 600 student musicians perform in this annual holiday spectacular, often filmed for national broadcast on PBS or Prime Video.
cards.short_summary: Christmas at Belmont is a massive annual holiday concert featuring the university's School of Music.
cards.evidence_claim: Christmas at Belmont features more than 600 student musicians and vocalists and has been a treasured tradition since 2003.
cards.access_notes: Held annually at the Fisher Center for the Performing Arts; tickets are required for live attendance.

cards.title: The Bell Tower Chimes
cards.subtitle: The Soundtrack of Campus
cards.notes: Listen for the carillon bells that chime every hour from 9:00 AM to 8:00 PM, a tradition dating back to the Ward-Belmont era.
cards.short_summary: The Belmont Bell Tower and Carillon is a historic landmark that chimes hourly.
cards.evidence_claim: The current Belmont University Tower and Carillon chimes each hour from 9:00am–8:00pm and is a symbol of the university.
cards.access_notes: The tower is a visible campus landmark; chimes are audible throughout the central grounds.

cards.title: Fall Follies
cards.subtitle: Student-Led Sketch Comedy
cards.notes: Attend this SNL-style comedy show where students poke fun at campus life, faculty, and Nashville culture.
cards.short_summary: Fall Follies is a long-running student sketch comedy production at Belmont.
cards.evidence_claim: Inspired by 'Saturday Night Live,' Fall Follies puts a comedic spin on the everyday life at Belmont.
cards.source_title: Fall Follies previews: the players - Belmont Vision
cards.access_notes: Performances are typically held in the fall semester at campus theaters.

cards.title: Throwback Prom
cards.subtitle: A Retro Dance Tradition
cards.notes: Dress up in vintage attire for this themed dance held on the first Friday of the fall semester.
cards.short_summary: Throwback Prom is a popular annual themed dance for the student body.
cards.evidence_claim: Throwback Prom is a must-attend first Friday in the fall event where students dress for a specific theme.
cards.access_notes: Open to all Belmont students; typically held in the Curb Event Center or Maddox Grand Atrium.

cards.title: FS Live
cards.subtitle: The Philanthropy Showcase
cards.notes: Watch Greek organizations compete in a high-energy dance and song showcase to raise money for St. Jude Children's Research Hospital.
cards.short_summary: FS Live (formerly Greek Sing) is the major annual philanthropy event for Belmont's Greek life.
cards.evidence_claim: FS Live, formerly known as Greek Sing, brings together fraternities and sororities to raise money for St. Jude.
cards.source_title: FS Live Raises Nearly 90k for Charity - Belmont University
cards.access_notes: Held annually in the spring at the Curb Event Center.

cards.title: Day to Dream
cards.subtitle: Fall Festival on the Lawn
cards.notes: Enjoy carnival rides, food trucks, and live music on the campus lawn during this annual fall celebration.
cards.short_summary: Day to Dream is a campus-wide fall festival featuring entertainment and community building.
cards.evidence_claim: Day to Dream is a celebration full of unforgettable events for the campus community, including carnival rides.
cards.access_notes: Typically held on the main campus lawn during the fall semester.

cards.title: The Showcase Series
cards.subtitle: Music City Talent on Stage
cards.notes: Attend these student-run concerts featuring genres like Rock, Pop, and Country, culminating in the 'Best of the Best' finale.
cards.short_summary: The Showcase Series is a professional-grade concert series produced and performed by students.
cards.evidence_claim: The Showcase Series is a full-scale concert production completely run by Belmont students, featuring various genres.
cards.access_notes: Shows are held throughout the academic year, primarily in the Curb Event Center.

cards.title: Bruiser the Bruin
cards.subtitle: The Mascot's Evolution
cards.notes: High-five Bruiser at athletic events; the mascot was introduced in 1995 when the university transitioned from the 'Rebels' to 'Bruins'.
cards.short_summary: Bruiser is the official mascot of Belmont University athletics.
cards.evidence_claim: The program's mascot is Bruiser the Bruin, introduced in 1995 when the nickname was changed from the Rebels.
cards.access_notes: Bruiser appears at home basketball games and major campus events.

boards.title: Your First Weekend at Belmont University, Shared as Cards
boards.description: Build a plausible under-21-safe first-weekend sequence, not a ranking. Give each card one role in the sequence and use evergreen places or recurring behaviors rather than one-time events. Be conservative about hours, access, and travel time unless directly sourced.

cards.title: Kick Off with Bruin Bash
cards.subtitle: Thursday Night Welcome
cards.notes: Head to the Main Lawn on Thursday night to grab your free Belmont T-shirt and meet fellow new Bruins during this student-only social event.
cards.short_summary: A Thursday night social event on the Main Lawn for new students to receive university merchandise and socialize.
cards.evidence_claim: Bruin Bash takes place on the Main Lawn from 7:30-9:00 pm on the Thursday of Welcome Week for students to get free T-shirts.
cards.access_notes: Open to all new students; check-in usually required for merchandise.

cards.title: Attend the Opening Session
cards.subtitle: Friday Evening Assembly
cards.notes: Join the Orientation Council and university leadership in the arena to officially begin your academic journey with your Towering Traditions group.
cards.short_summary: The official opening session for Welcome Week held in the university's primary athletic and event arena.
cards.evidence_claim: The Opening Session for Welcome Week is held at the Curb Event Center on Friday evening.
cards.access_notes: Mandatory for new students; guests are welcome to attend this specific session.

cards.title: Fuel Up at the Dining Hall
cards.subtitle: Saturday Morning Brunch
cards.notes: Visit the second floor of the Johnson Center for an all-you-care-to-eat meal with your new roommates before the day's activities begin.
cards.short_summary: The primary campus dining hall located in the R. Milton and Denice Johnson Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Harrington Place Dining is located on the second floor of the R. Milton and Denice Johnson Center and serves as the main dining hall.
cards.access_notes: Requires a meal plan or Bruin Bucks; open for standard meal periods.

cards.title: Meet at the Bell Tower
cards.subtitle: Saturday Afternoon Landmark
cards.notes: Use this iconic 105-foot carillon as a central meeting point for your Towering Traditions group before heading to afternoon breakout sessions.
cards.short_summary: A historic 105-foot carillon and central campus landmark used as a primary gathering spot.
cards.evidence_claim: The Bell Tower is a central campus landmark and a key point of interest on the university's walking tour.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor landmark accessible 24/7; interior access is restricted.

cards.title: Explore the Rec Center
cards.subtitle: Saturday Afternoon Activity
cards.notes: Check out the climbing wall or the fitness center to see where you'll be staying active between classes this semester.
cards.short_summary: The hub for student organizations and campus recreation, featuring fitness facilities and a climbing wall.
cards.evidence_claim: The Beaman Student Life Center houses recreational space including a climbing wall and fitness rooms.
cards.access_notes: Requires a valid student ID for entry to fitness areas.

cards.title: Catch a Student Showcase
cards.subtitle: Saturday Night Entertainment
cards.notes: Visit this student-run venue to hear live music from your talented classmates in an intimate, alcohol-free setting.
cards.short_summary: A restaurant and entertainment venue on campus that hosts student-run live music performances.
cards.evidence_claim: The Curb Café is a restaurant and entertainment venue for students that hosts live shows Thursday through Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Open to the community; check the online calendar for specific performance times.

cards.title: Sunday Morning Worship
cards.subtitle: Sunday Morning Tradition
cards.notes: Attend the interdenominational worship service in the campus chapel, a traditional part of the Welcome Week schedule for students and families.
cards.short_summary: The campus chapel located in the Janet Ayers Academic Center, hosting university worship services.
cards.evidence_claim: A Sunday Worship Service is held during Welcome Week and is one of the events parents are invited to attend.
cards.access_notes: Located in the Janet Ayers Academic Center; open to all students and guests.

cards.title: The Matriculation Ceremony
cards.subtitle: Sunday Morning Milestone
cards.notes: Participate in this formal ceremony that officially inducts you into the Belmont community as a new student.
cards.short_summary: A formal academic ceremony marking the official entry of new students into the university.
cards.evidence_claim: The Matriculation Ceremony takes place on Sunday morning during Welcome Week.
cards.access_notes: Mandatory for all new students; parents typically depart campus following this event.

cards.title: Find Your Study Spot
cards.subtitle: Sunday Afternoon Prep
cards.notes: Walk through the library to locate the quiet study floors and the Leu Art Gallery before classes begin on Monday.
cards.short_summary: The main university library, housing academic resources and the Leu Art Gallery.
cards.evidence_claim: The Lila D. Bunch Library is building #18 on the campus map and contains the Leu Art Gallery.
cards.access_notes: Check library website for specific Sunday hours during Welcome Week.

cards.title: Gear Up for Monday
cards.subtitle: Sunday Afternoon Shopping
cards.notes: Stop by the campus store in the Gabhart Student Center to pick up any last-minute supplies or Belmont gear for your first day of class.
cards.short_summary: The official university bookstore and merchandise shop located in the Gabhart Student Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The BruinShop is located in the Gabhart Student Center and sells university merchandise and course materials.
cards.access_notes: Located on the first floor of the Gabhart Student Center.
